description.p: Refract is a system monitor for KDE Plasma made of glass: its sidebar, toolbar, menus and sheets frost and bend whatever is behind them, over a window that shows your desktop through KWin's own blur.

ul.li: Live graphs for every CPU core, memory, disks, Wi-Fi and Ethernet, GPUs, fans and batteries
Apps and processes with CPU, memory, disk and GPU use, search, a process tree, and Stop, Quit or Force Quit
System and user systemd services: status, start, stop, restart, enable, disable and logs
Your icon theme, accent colour and wallpaper; light, dark or automatic appearance

description.p: Refract is a modified version of Mission Center and uses its data engine, magpie. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mission Center developers.
